exposure: Pre-pregnancy BMI (3 levels) and PWG (3 levels)
cohort: 1207 women from a New York county who initiated exclusive or any breastfeeding
finding: Women of normal and obese pre-pregnancy BMI with greater-than-recommended PWG had an increased risk of any breastfeeding cessation within the first 3 months postpartum compared to women with normal pre-pregnancy BMI who gained within PWG recommendations.
